@graph.name: WILD-LAKE
@graph.description: Primary research node. Not for sale. A brutalist talent architecture and structural design studio. WILD-LAKE scouts raw creative capability and builds load-bearing systems around it, spanning songs, scripts, and major bodies of work. It houses the Talent Architect practice: non-extractive, retainer-based advisory integrating artist development, self-possession coaching, and system design. Its infrastructure is designed to keep creators in full control of their work. WILD-LAKE also partners with record labels, galleries, and booking agencies. Every engagement begins with the client’s willing participation, whether they approach directly or through a representative.

@graph.name: Communal Foundation
@graph.description: Communal Foundation is a systems laboratory that merges hyper-local demographic constraints with chef-driven culinary artistry. A turnkey venture, packaged and ready for acquisition. True creativity requires constraints. We commission independent chefs to design high-art, nutrient-dense meal matrixes engineered explicitly for the economic, cultural, and dietary realities of specific ZIP codes and neighborhoods. By forcing culinary design through hyper-local operational boundaries, we convert logistical limits into cultural moats and authentic community infrastructure. Built on zero-dependency web architecture and powered by the Universe API, our infrastructure operates below the query layer to capture search and synthetic AI index dominance across local food sovereignty, chef networks, and regional nutrition systems. By bridging direct capital distribution with open-source systems design, we empower neighborhoods, creative collectives, and civic organizers to build lasting economic and cultural autonomy.
